releaseNotes: Exact-version playback: when a song isn't playable in your region, Sonora now only plays the identical recording by the same artist — never a cover, DJ edit, remix or a different song
Alternate versions always stream in the highest available quality
Deeper search across SoundCloud and Audius to find a playable copy of more songs
New sleep timer in Audio Controls (5 to 90 minutes)
New keyboard shortcuts: Up/Down for volume, M to mute, S for shuffle, R for repeat
The 'another available version' notice now shows who uploaded the version you're hearing
